messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: INCIDENT PD-87421 fired for private-controlplane-heartbeat (customer: acme-enterprises). Severity: P1. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-87421
pagerduty-bot: Incident auto-assigned to Alex (oncall). Notifying escalation policy. Escalation timer: 15m.
Alex (oncall): Acked. I'm on it — starting triage. Any customer-visible failures? Priya (cs) can you confirm? :eyes: 
Priya (cs): Customer reporting 502s on their control plane API and some agent reconnections failing since ~12:16 UTC. They're seeing ~40% of requests erroring.
Maya (sre): Looking at metrics — controlplane heartbeat drops for acme cluster at 12:14 -> 12:29. KV cache miss spike and agent-side kvcache-stale logs.
Lee (eng-ops): I can't reach the onprem-agent host via our management VPC. SSH times out at bastion. Traceroute stops at customer's NAT (10.44.8.1).
Alex (oncall): Running quick checks: ```
# check agent process from control plane
curl -sS https://private-controlplane/acme/agents/agent-03/health || true
# ping via bastion
ssh bastion "traceroute -n 10.44.8.12 | tail -n+1"
```
Maya (sre): Logs from control plane show repeated TLS handshake resets from agent-03 followed by connection closed. Potential network flap or customer firewall change.
Sam (netops): On it. I'm opening a ticket with the transit provider and checking BGP/peer flaps. Any recent ACL changes on acme side? Priya can you ask customer?
Priya (cs): Pinged customer. They say no intentional firewall changes, but they did push a new iptables rule around 12:10 for a maintenance window. They thought it was internal-only. Waiting on their infra team to confirm exact rule.
Lee (eng-ops): If customer pushed iptables that blocks healthcheck ports (8443/9191), that'll explain it. We should prepare a mitigation: 1) ask customer to temporarily allow controlplane CIDRs, 2) enable emergency fallback to hosted-controlplane-readonly to reduce customer impact.
Alex (oncall): Agree. Priya, can you get explicit approval for hosted fallback? We need consent to route agent traffic to our hosted control plane and rotate certs if required.
Priya (cs): Customer approves temporary fallback to hosted-controlplane-readonly for 30m while they revert firewall. They also want updates every 10m.
Maya (sre): Preparing runbook steps — if we failover, we must: ```
- update routing policy for acme cluster to hosted-controlplane-readonly
- bump agent connection TTL and monitor kvcache warmup
- keep read-only mode, no writes allowed
```
Alex (oncall): I'll do the failover now. Noting we need to hand off to next oncall at 13:00 UTC. If unresolved by then, escalate to SRE lead.
pagerduty-bot: PD-87421 acknowledged by Alex at 12:21 UTC. Escalation hold set for 15m.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Failover executed at 12:26 UTC to hosted-controlplane-readonly for acme cluster. Monitoring for error rate reduction.
Maya (sre): After failover, error rate dropped from ~40% -> 6% within 3m. KV cache warming ongoing but requests largely succeeding.
Sam (netops): Transit provider says there was a transient NAT overload matching the window; they routed traffic differently at 12:24. Customer still needs to revert iptables.
Priya (cs): Customer reverted the iptables rule at 12:34 and confirms connectivity restoration. They request rollback from fallback when stable.
Lee (eng-ops): Let's coordinate rollback window. We'll keep fallback for 10 more minutes, then move agents back to private control plane and monitor for 10m.
Alex (oncall): Rolling agents back now. Steps executed, monitoring.
Maya (sre): Post-rollback, latency and success rates are back to baseline after 5m. No further TLS resets seen.
Priya (cs): Customer confirms normal behavior. They're thankful for the quick response.
Alex (oncall): Great. I'll close the PD incident once we pass the 30m stability check. Handoff: I'm handing to next oncall (Jordan) at 13:00 UTC to confirm postmortem items and action tracking. @Jordan please pick up at 13:00.
pagerduty-bot: PD-87421 status: Resolved (manual) at 13:02 UTC by Alex.
Maya (sre): Action items: [1] document recommended customer firewall rules for private-controlplane ports, [2] add automated fallback approval checklist to runbook, [3] update monitoring to alert earlier on TLS handshake resets.
Alex (oncall): Noted. Closing thread after PM ticket created. Thanks all. :tada:
